Our services

Everything your outdoor space needs

Our team of experienced professionals specializes in all aspects of landscape and lawn care, from regular maintenance and mowing to intricate design and installation projects.

Landscape Design & Installation

We start with a thorough site analysis, then work closely with you to develop a design that maximizes the use and enjoyment of your outdoor space.

Lawn Spraying & Fertilization

Lawn spraying, fertilization, and aeration — the treatments that keep your lawn thick, green, and healthy through the season.

Grading & Excavation

Grading and excavation with the right equipment for the job, from site prep to drainage — plus land clearing when the property needs a fresh start.

Sod Installation

Fresh sod installation for a lawn that looks finished from day one — measured, laid, and watered in properly.

Snow & Ice Services

De-icing, spreading, and snow & ice removal for homes and businesses — with ice melt for sale by the bag or pallet.

Fire Ant Control

Fire ant control for lawns and landscapes, so your yard stays safe to walk, play, and work in.

Also available: regular lawn maintenance and mowing, and land clearing.

Who we are

A full-service landscape design firm

ProSpray Solutions is a full-service landscape design firm located in Red Oak, NC. We specialize in creating unique and functional outdoor spaces that enhance the beauty and value of our clients’ homes and businesses.

Our team of experienced landscape designers combines creativity and expertise to develop custom designs that meet the specific needs and preferences of each of our clients — and we are dedicated to delivering exceptional landscapes that exceed our clients’ expectations.
